title: Regulatory Sandboxes for Small-Scale Carbon Offsetting Projects
what_it_is: Regulatory Sandboxes for Small-Scale Carbon Offsetting Projects

sections.label: Singapore carbon credit sandboxes and hub
sections.summary: Singapore runs carbon credit regulatory sandboxes, signs MOUs with over 10 countries, and works on an ICC registry and carbon tax offsets.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Since 2021, the Government has been implementing regulatory sandboxes for carbon credit projects to support the development of regulatory processes and infrastructure that are integral to carbon markets and the broader green finance ecosystem.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We conduct such sandboxes in collaboration with like-minded countries and/or private sector partners in accordance with Article 6 of the Paris Agreement on international carbon credits.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Singapore actively co-facilitated Article 6 negotiations at COP26 and COP27, and participates in platforms such as the Voluntary Carbon Markets Integrity Initiative to drive the harmonisation of rules and standards.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We supported the World Bank and the International Emissions Trading Association to anchor the Climate Action Data Trust in Singapore, which connects registries to promote transparency and market confidence.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We are actively fostering international partnerships and have signed memoranda of understanding (MOUs) with more than 10 countries to facilitate access to high quality international carbon credits, or ICC.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Concurrently, we are working on the establishment of an ICC registry and consulting various stakeholders on environmental integrity criteria and whitelist of ICC that carbon tax-liable companies may use to offset up to 5% of their carbon tax liability.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Taken together, we are building our reputation as a trusted carbon services and trading hub, with over 100 ecosytem players now based in Singapore and are working with industry to enable further growth.

sections.label: IRAS carbon credit tax treatment
sections.summary: IRAS is creating transfer pricing considerations for carbon credits and announced their issuance, transfer and sale are not treated as used for GST.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: For example, the Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore (IRAS) is working to create transfer pricing considerations for relevant carbon credits.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: They have announced on 23 November that the issuance transfer and sale of carbon credits including the digitised form is to be treated as neither used for GST purposes.
